findings: guarantees invokes ReferenceRuntimeReceipt.guarantees once on the literal actual receipt and strengthens its same viewed outcome; all three guarantee predicates retain identical receipt fields.
Success strengthening keeps the exact published post tuple and source observation, attaching SuccessCertificate to that same post/out/frame.
REVERT strengthening retains actual frame REVERT gas/output plus exact pre-world/substate/created rollback and attaches the certificate to that same observed internal execution.
Exceptional branch is retained unchanged with actual error, non-OutOfFuel guard, zero gas and empty output; no source replay or payment certificate is invented.
Initial created binding is definitionally tx.created via initial frame tx, not pinned createdAccounts equality. WarmRelated remains an explicit initial source binding.
At is derived from the exact codeCall frame. Conditional PaymentFor grants remain inside named certificates, rather than asserted as protocol-admitted meter resources.
boundaries: Actual receipt/code/fuel pin, initial slots/warmth, calldata and initial-energy/host bound remain inputs.
Pre-journal invariant/budget require history producers; canonical extraction remains open.
Sufficient source-meter grant implications are not admission, executable interpreter parity or exceptional resource replay.
Certificates preserve terminal-entry warmth; final-post warmth remains a separate transport helper.
authorship_disclosure: Reviewer authored price-bound dependencies; independent root component reviews exist. This is independent root receipt-composition review.
